penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Building a functioning ORM-integrated admin framework requires bespoke integration work per customer stack; delivery is not automatable via Claude prompts.

penalties_applied.name: requires_synchronous_human
penalties_applied.reason: Sales to engineering teams at funded startups (especially healthtech) requires demos and scoping calls to close, and onboarding requires technical support sessions.

rationale: The pain is sharp and well-documented — engineering teams at funded startups genuinely waste weeks building internal admin tooling — and the buyer (engineering leads at B2B SaaS/healthtech startups) has real budget and willingness to pay as evidenced by Retool's commercial success. However, the solution is a complex developer framework requiring deep ORM and backend integration, which is architecturally far beyond Claude prompts and a simple page; buildability_with_ai and operational_autonomy both score 2. After applying the required penalties for per-customer delivery work and synchronous sales, the total collapses to 2.7. This is a strong real-world problem but the wrong shape for this factory.
solution_plan: This opportunity is not viable for this factory. An ORM-integrated admin dashboard framework is a substantial software product requiring significant engineering, custom per-customer integration, technical sales cycles with demos, and ongoing developer support. A solo non-technical operator using Claude prompts and a landing page cannot build or deliver this. The market is real — consider as a reference point for what buyers in this segment need — but drop as a factory micro-service target.
notes: buildability_with_ai (2) and operational_autonomy (2) both catastrophically fail build gates. Total after penalties is 2.7 — drop.
